newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Shinawatra Satel rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Shinawatra Satel rated buy.

text.p: Seamico Research said on Friday it rated Shinawatra Satellite a buy on an expected increase in cable TV competitiveness.

This will lead to rising demand for transponders which will benefit the company. Shinawatra Satellite is scheduled to launch its third satellite, Thaicom 3, in December. It share was trading down 0.25 baht at 34.50 at 0511 GMT.
Currently, there are three major cable television operators in Thailand -- UTV, IBC and ThaiSky.
UTV has 35 channels and the company was expected to expand its service to 45 channels. The local broadcast is scheduled to start in November.

"Not only will UTV's planned broadcast of 45 channels increase the demand for Ku-band transponder slots sharply, the company's competitive play will certainly be matched by competitors," the research said.
"This increased channel will benefit (Shinawatra Satellite) tremendously," it said.

Shinawatra Satellite's current capacity is 20 Cu-band and four Ku-band transponders, all utilised. The capacity will be increased to 44 Cu-band and 16 Ku-band transponders when Thaicom 3 is launched, Seamico said.
